description: DAO-CREATE: Workspaces(0).CreateDatabase on a new ACCDB path. File state and Databases.Count before and after; the returned Database's Name/Version and TableDefs.Count; a first CREATE TABLE; Close and reopen through the Workspace. Then, each followed by Errors and file state: CreateDatabase on the same path again; on the existing input fixture; with version 12345; with an invalid locale string; and inside a Workspace transaction that is rolled back.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1-err-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
